content.text:
ISSUE_KIND: road_damage
ISSUE: Large sinkhole and collapsed concrete roadway pavement around a manhole
DETAILS: The photo shows a severe collapse of concrete street pavement creating a deep sinkhole next to a circular manhole cover, with a wooden frame wrapped in yellow caution tape and a metal signpost leaning inside the hole. There is no user note.
ORGANIZATION: Prince George's County Department of Public Works and Transportation
DEPARTMENT: Office of Highway Maintenance, Road Maintenance and Road Construction Division
WHY: Tecumseh Street in Adelphi is an unnumbered residential street in an unincorporated area of Prince George's County. In Prince George's County, unnumbered public streets outside incorporated municipalities are County-maintained roadways, and the Department of Public Works and Transportation's Office of Highway Maintenance is responsible for repairing sinkholes, potholes, and roadway pavement failures on County-maintained roads.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "As part of the Prince George's County Roadway Preservation Program, maintenance includes the repair of sinkholes and potholes, shoulder repair, removal and replacement of concrete curb and gutter, sidewalks, driveway aprons, the installation of underdrains, the installation and/or upgrade of handicapped access ramps per ADA standards and the repair/resurfacing of the roadway pavement."
COVERAGE_URL: https://www.princegeorgescountymd.gov/departments-offices/public-works-transportation/about-dpwt/office-highway-maintenance
